data.summary: At 15,229,806 views and a 3.8% like-to-view ratio, “Full Vid 👇” is resonating as a challenge; the strongest likely driver is thumbnail. Treat each factor below as a hypothesis grounded in the public data — not a guarantee.

why_trending.detail: A high-contrast thumbnail with a clear focal subject likely lifts the initial tap rate against a busy Shorts feed.
The setup withholds the resolution, likely driving rewatches and completion — both strong short-form ranking signals.
The topic taps a timely, high-interest subject, so audience intent is likely already searching for and engaging with it.
The Short appears to ride a currently-popular sound or format, so it likely surfaces inside an already-hot trend cluster.
The framing targets a broad, relatable everyday situation, which likely widens the share-and-comment audience.

Cut every dead beat — one idea per shot; let the pace carry it.
Sync a key action to a sound that's trending right NOW (not an evergreen track).
